shortDescription: British digital bank Monzo is in talks about a sale to Brazil's Nubank that could value it at between £8 billion and £10 billion ($10.6-$13.25 billion), Sky News reported on Saturday.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.($1 = 0.7547 pounds)

children: British digital bank Monzo is in talks about a sale to Brazil's Nubank that could value it at between £8 billion and £10 billion ($10.6-$13.25 billion), Sky News reported on Saturday.
